compute.note: Seconds of a run = serial wall-clock time of that run in one process; the sum over the records is the total serial-equivalent compute (CPU-seconds). Runs were executed in parallel worker processes (multiprocessing Pool, several shards on a 4-core machine), so the elapsed time of a study is much shorter than its total; ratio_cpu_to_shard_wall = sum of the run Seconds of a logged shard / its logged wall time (= average number of concurrently busy workers).
